data.name: Aura of Menace
data.description: At 8th level, you can emit a 30-foot aura of menace as a standard action. Enemies in this aura take a -2 penalty to AC and on attacks and saves as long as they remain inside the aura. You can use this ability %1 rounds per day. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.|DomainGoodLVL
